annotation.title_clean: 交通运输部 工业和信息化部 国家能源局关于印发《内河新能源船舶推广应用行动方案（2026—2030年）》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and National Energy Administration on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting Application of New-Energy Inland Waterway Vessels (2026–2030)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 交通运输部; 工业和信息化部; 国家能源局
annotation.summary_en: Chinese ministries' notice issuing an action plan (2026–2030) to promote new-energy inland waterway vessels, such as electric and methanol-powered ships. It sets targets for 2028 and 2030 and encourages deployment scenarios. It does not address AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: By 2028, new-energy inland vessel stock doubles from 2025, with over 1,000 electric cargo ships and over 100 methanol ships.
Build 3,000 km of zero-carbon waterway corridors by 2028.
Promote electric ships for routes under 300 km and under 3,000 dwt.
Promote methanol-powered ships for long-distance, large-tonnage freight.
Encourage hydrogen, biodiesel and green methanol exploration.
